article.title: How to Compare JSON Files Online & Find Differences
article.content:
Why Compare JSON?

Comparing JSON documents is essential for debugging APIs, verifying configuration changes, and ensuring data integrity. Whether you're checking API responses, comparing config files, or validating data migrations, a JSON diff tool helps you spot every difference quickly.

Common Use Cases

  • API Debugging: Compare expected vs actual API responses to find bugs
  • Configuration Changes: Track changes between config file versions
  • Data Migration: Verify data was transferred correctly between systems
  • Code Review: Compare JSON payloads in pull requests

How to Compare JSON Online

  1. Paste JSON A (original) in the left panel
  2. Paste JSON B (modified) in the right panel
  3. Click Compare to see all differences highlighted
  4. Review results — added, removed, and changed values are color-coded

Understanding Diff Results

  • Added (Green): New keys or values in JSON B
  • Removed (Red): Keys or values present in JSON A but missing in JSON B
  • Changed (Yellow): Values that exist in both but have different values

Best Practices

  • Format first: Use JSON formatter to ensure both documents are readable
  • Check structure: Ensure both JSONs have similar structure before comparing
  • Export results: Copy or download diff results for documentation
  • Use URL input: Compare remote API responses directly via URL

article.title: 如何在线比较 JSON 文件并查找差异
article.content:
为什么要比较 JSON？

比较 JSON 文档对于调试 API、验证配置更改和确保数据完整性至关重要。无论你是检查 API 响应、比较配置文件还是验证数据迁移，JSON 差异工具都能帮助你快速发现每个差异。

常见使用场景

  • API 调试：比较预期与实际的 API 响应以查找错误
  • 配置更改：跟踪配置文件版本之间的更改
  • 数据迁移：验证数据是否在系统之间正确传输
  • 代码审查：比较 Pull Request 中的 JSON 负载

如何在线比较 JSON

  1. 粘贴 JSON A（原始）到左侧面板
  2. 粘贴 JSON B（修改后）到右侧面板
  3. 点击比较查看所有高亮显示的差异
  4. 查看结果 — 新增、删除和修改的值用不同颜色标记

理解差异结果

  • 新增（绿色）：JSON B 中的新键或值
  • 删除（红色）：JSON A 中存在但 JSON B 中缺失的键或值
  • 修改（黄色）：在两个文档中都存在但值不同的键

最佳实践

  • 先格式化：使用 JSON 格式化工具确保两个文档可读
  • 检查结构：比较前确保两个 JSON 具有相似的结构
  • 导出结果：复制或下载差异结果用于文档记录
  • 使用 URL 输入：直接通过 URL 比较远程 API 响应
